digest.component_or_area: verifier model-class resolution across plan-review, completion, and code-review gates
propositions: Three separate verifier code paths select the model via an equality test against the default model, so any non-default (e.g. Bedrock or provider-qualified) id silently stops applying the downgrade.
The fix replaces the equality tests with a single shared resolve_model_string that resolves reserved class names (trivial/standard/frontier) and returns any other string unchanged.
The code-review.yaml verify step declares no model: key and falls through to cfg.model, so its Pass-2 greedy verification runs on the frontier model and loses determinism.
Adding model: standard to the code-review verify step, combined with resolve_model resolving class names, routes that step through the standard class rather than cfg.model.
A cross-provider negative-control test asserts no verifier path resolves a model belonging to a different provider when classes are configured for a non-default provider.
resolve_model_string must return a literal model id byte-for-byte unchanged to preserve back-compat for existing workflow YAML.
